intro: 'Not Dead Yet' is an urgent plea from Eralya, a mortally wounded night elf discovered after a disastrous mission toward the Oracle Tree. Overwhelmed by vicious harpies, she begs travelers to deliver word of her patrol's fate to Byancie in Dolanaar. It highlights the deadly threats encroaching upon the woodland paths of Teldrassil.
